exposure: novel splice-site variant in KLHL40 gene (c.1607+3A>T)
cohort: The participants are three affected individuals in a family diagnosed with Nemaline myopathy (NEM8).
finding: The study identified a novel splice-site variant in the KLHL40 gene (c.1607+3A>T) in three family members presenting with variable phenotypes of severe Nemaline myopathy (NEM8).
